strapiBlog.title: Top 20 Social Media Influencers Living in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Over the years, Dubai has evolved into the global capital for influencers.

data.text:
Over the years, Dubai has evolved into the global capital for influencers. From TikTok stars and YouTube sensations to fashion and lifestyle moguls, the city is buzzing with social media royalty who have chosen to call it home. But what makes this trend even more fascinating is the growing appetite for ultra-luxury living. These influencers aren’t just chasing views—they’re also acquiring some of the city's most extravagant residences.

So which of the social media celebrities are living in Dubai right now? We’re here to shine the spotlight on the stars who are calling the golden city their home.

Top Social Media Influencers Living in Dubai Right Now

Let’s take a look at 20 of the top social media influencers who not only live in Dubai but have invested in its world-class real estate scene. These personalities aren’t just here for the views; they’re reshaping the narrative around celebrity real estate in Dubai.

1. Huda Kattan (@hudabeauty)

One of the most influential beauty moguls in the world, Huda lives in a palatial villa in Emirates Hills—an exclusive gated community renowned for its opulent estates and celebrity residents. Her luxurious home reflects her global stature and reinforces her place among the elite celebrities who live in Dubai.

2. Mo Vlogs (@movlogs)

Known for his supercar vlogs, Mo Vlogs resides in a sprawling mansion in Dubai Hills Estate—a premium gated community celebrated for its lush landscapes and proximity to elite schools and golf courses. 

His content frequently showcases his lavish lifestyle, offering followers a glimpse into high-end interiors, private car collections, and the grandeur that defines the luxury homes of Dubai influencers.

3. Lana Rose (@lanarose786)

The YouTuber and music artist lives in a glamorous villa next to her brother Mo Vlogs, nestled within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate. 

Her tastefully designed home features grand interiors, high-end finishes, and a custom layout tailored for content creation. Frequently showcased in her vlogs, it perfectly illustrates how influencers buying property in Dubai are prioritizing lifestyle, creative freedom, and long-term value over just centrality.

4. Khalid Al Ameri (@khalidalameri)

A household name in the Middle East, Khalid shares his inspiring stories from a spacious villa in Jumeirah—a coastal community known for its upscale ambiance and beachfront charm. 

His home reflects a harmonious balance between tradition and modern luxury, and his decision to settle in Dubai makes him one of the most admired celebrities who live in Dubai.

5. Naomi D'Souza (@naomi_dsouza)

Known for her polished aesthetic and content on food and travel, Naomi resides in a modern loft-style apartment in Business Bay. 

With sleek interiors, panoramic canal views, and tech-forward features, her residence embodies sophistication and creativity. Her space reflects the emerging trend of luxury homes of Dubai influencers designed to complement both lifestyle and content creation.

6. Safa Siddiqui (@safa_dubai)

The Dubai Bling star lives in an ultra-stylish villa in Al Barari with her husband, surrounded by lush greenery and serene water features that define the eco-conscious luxury of the community. 

Their home's contemporary design, complete with floor-to-ceiling windows and custom interiors, puts them firmly on the radar for influencers buying property in Dubai who seek both privacy and sophistication.

7. Noor Stars (@noorstars)

This YouTube sensation owns a chic apartment with sweeping views of the Dubai skyline, ideally located in one of the city's most vibrant high-rise neighborhoods. 

Outfitted with designer touches and smart-home features, her residence is a perfect reflection of her modern style and growing influence. Noor represents a new wave of celebrities in Dubai right now investing in branded residences.

8. Joelle Mardinian (@joellemardinian)

The founder of beauty empire Joelle Group lives in a custom-designed villa in Al Barsha, a vibrant neighborhood known for its blend of community charm and upscale convenience. Her residence, complete with elegant interiors and bespoke finishes, doubles as a creative space and brand statement. 

Her home is not just her sanctuary but also an extension of her personal brand in the world of celebrity real estate in Dubai.

9. Bin Baz (@bin_baz)

Famous for his comedy skits, Bin Baz has reportedly bought a modern home in Arabian Ranches—a gated community known for its family-friendly vibe, landscaped parks, and spacious villas. 

His playful content often features snippets from his daily life in this tranquil setting, giving viewers a peek into how influencers blend creativity with comfort in suburban Dubai.

10. Nour Arida (@nouraridaofficial)

This Lebanese influencer calls Downtown Dubai her home. Her high-rise apartment is a chic urban retreat, complete with floor-to-ceiling windows, minimalist interiors, and sweeping skyline views. The space mirrors her elegant fashion content and serves as a versatile setting for photoshoots and brand collaborations.

11. Narins Beauty (@narins_beauty)

With a fanbase across continents, Narin lives in a penthouse in Dubai Marina—one of the city's most iconic waterfront neighborhoods. 

Her luxurious space, adorned with sleek furnishings and panoramic marina views, doubles as a studio for her creative projects, blending elegance with productivity in a setting that epitomizes modern influencer living.

12. Ghaith Marwan (@ghaithmarwan)

Often seen exploring Dubai's hotspots, Ghaith is known to reside in a fully furnished smart home in Jumeirah Village Circle—a community that blends affordability with modern design. His home is optimized for seamless content creation, complete with voice-controlled lighting, stylish decor, and flexible workspaces that suit his dynamic digital lifestyle.

13. Asmaa Ibraheem (@asmaa_ibraheem)

The TV host and influencer has been spotted in a duplex loft apartment in Palm Jumeirah, one of the most prestigious addresses in the city. Her residence offers stunning sea views, elegant open-plan living spaces, and proximity to luxury beach resorts and fine dining. 

This stylish setting perfectly aligns with her glamorous on-screen persona and social media appeal.

14. Mahmoud (@mrmoudz)

His artistic feed often features shots of his Downtown Dubai home, where fashion meets interior design in every detail. The apartment’s sleek layout, designer furnishings, and panoramic views make it a perfect backdrop for high-end content creation and collaborations with global luxury brands.

15. Eva Zuk (@eva_zuk)

A model and luxury enthusiast, Eva lives in a designer residence in Dubai Creek Harbour, overlooking the city skyline. 

Her apartment features sleek contemporary architecture, floor-to-ceiling windows, and curated interiors that reflect her refined taste. With easy access to waterfront promenades and retail boulevards, her home epitomizes high-end living in one of Dubai’s most visionary master-planned communities.

16. Nael Abu Alteen (@nael_abu_alteen)

Famed for his cinematic travel content, Nael has made a statement by moving into a loft in City Walk—an urban lifestyle hub known for its pedestrian-friendly design, trendy cafes, and upscale retail outlets. 

His residence offers a creative yet refined atmosphere, ideal for editing content, hosting collaborators, and immersing in Dubai’s buzzing cultural scene—all while combining accessibility with elegance.

17. Gehna Advani (@gehnaadvani)

Beauty meets tranquility in her Al Habtoor City apartment, where high ceilings and natural light set the scene for her brand collaborations. 

Overlooking the Dubai Water Canal, her elegant home is equipped with luxury amenities and contemporary finishes that provide a serene yet sophisticated environment ideal for content creation and upscale living.

18. Anas Elshayib (@anas_elshayib)

Anas lives in a stylish townhouse in Dubai South, a location gaining traction among young influencers for its spacious layouts, affordability, and growing infrastructure. 

The community offers a peaceful, suburban vibe while still being connected to key areas via the Expo Road and metro link, making it a smart lifestyle choice for creators seeking balance.

19. Cedra Ammara (@cedrabeauty)

Her classic-yet-modern apartment in DIFC reflects both her taste and her status in Dubai’s influencer scene. 
With its high ceilings, sleek design palette, and proximity to world-class restaurants and art galleries, her home exudes urban sophistication. It's a natural choice for content creators who seek both aesthetic elegance and strategic location.

20. Hunain Riaz (@hunainriaz)

Known for his animated and family-friendly content, Hunain recently moved into a smart villa in DAMAC Hills 2—a rapidly growing community on the outskirts of Dubai. 

His villa is equipped with integrated smart systems, energy-efficient features, and open-plan spaces tailored for both personal life and filming. Surrounded by greenery, play areas, and sports facilities, it offers a peaceful yet modern environment well-suited to his digital persona.

These personalities highlight a growing trend of social media elites establishing permanent roots in the emirate. For more celebrity property insights, check out our blog on 10 celebrities who live in Dubai.

faqs.question: Why are so many influencers moving to Dubai?

data.answer: Dubai offers tax-free income, high safety standards, luxury lifestyle options, and excellent connectivity, making it a prime destination.

faqs.question: Which areas in Dubai are most popular with influencers?

data.answer: Emirates Hills, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Hills Estate, Downtown Dubai, and Business Bay are top choices.

faqs.question: What types of properties do influencers prefer?

data.answer: From smart lofts to beachfront villas, influencers choose homes that align with their personal brand and content style.
